big_case.notes: Independent read, formed from the application and the docket before weighing the candidates' scores. A genuinely novel church-autonomy and compelled-speech question (a civil court barring a litigant from a beis din and ordering him to seek withdrawal of a seruv), with elite counsel on both sides and a Becket Fund amicus. But it is a private nursing-home ownership dispute, the relief sought was interim and party-specific, and the Circuit Justice denied it in chambers without referral, without a noted dissent, and expressly on exhaustion grounds. Moderate stakes, well below an election or public-program application.
